From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form onboarding — initial redline packet & signer clarification

Hi Ellis —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. To keep contracting moving this week, can you: 

- Share the latest MSA and the fully-signed/filled order form (if you have a PDF).
- Confirm who will sign on BrightKey's side (name + title + email) so we can map approvals and DocuSign fields.
- Let us know any non-standard clauses you expect in the redline (data residency, indemnity caps, export controls).

I've looped in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (commercial ops) to pick up redline review and billing contacts. On our side we typically: 

1) Run a redline pass in Legal (target 2 business days)
2) Surface any high-priority objections for a short call (15–30m)
3) Prepare an Order Form that matches your billing cadence and exhibit entries

If you can drop the docs now we will kick off the internal review.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | sergio@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Thanks Sergio — attaching the MSA draft and the order form PDF. A few notes up front: 

- Attachments: BrightKey_MSA_v1.docx; BrightKey_OrderForm_2025-08-12.pdf
- Signing authority: Nora Li, Head of Finance (nora.li@brightkey.ai) — authorized to sign contracts up to $250k.
- Expected changes: we usually ask for a 60-day SLA cap in Exhibit B, and we have a standard data processing addendum (DPA) that we'd like to include as Exhibit D.

We'd prefer to avoid an indemnity cap below 1x annual fees; open to discussion. If Redwood has standard language, please propose alternatives.

Happy to do a 20-minute legal sync tomorrow; otherwise we'll wait for your redline. 

Best,
Ellis Park

ellis@brightkey.ai | (206) 555-4432
